messages:
jordan (pm): Quick sync — need to lock down launch criteria for the Console observability slice we promised for Q2. Scope: dashboards (cost + error), tracing hooks (sampling & linkability), and per-route cost deltas. What are definite must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
alex (product): Must-haves: per-route cost breakdown (tokens, hardware adj), top-10 error buckets with example traces, and trace linkability from frontend request -> model call. Nice-to-have: per-customer billing mapping, advanced sampling UI.
maria (eng): For tracing hooks we need a minimal, low-risk API: propagate trace_id with each request, auto-instrument model calls to emit span summaries, and export full traces on sample. Implementation sketch: core propagation + span summary = ~3 dev days, full sampling pipeline + storage configs = ~2 weeks.
sam (sre): Important: retention/storage cost. We can't run full traces at 100% without huge ingestion. Recommend default: lightweight span summaries at 100% (latency, error-tag, token-count) + full-trace sampling at low rate. Adaptive sampling for error/latency spikes.
jordan (pm): @sam define low rate we can ship with as default. We need a number we can promise for Hosted and Dedicated tiers.
sam (sre): Default idea: 5% full traces across traffic, 100% span summaries. Adaptive bump to 25% for any flow with error rate >2% or p95 latency > 1.5s. For Dedicated customers, allow config up to 50% with cost warnings.
kevin (observability): Dashboard requirements: 1) cost-per-route time series (tokens, infra adj), 2) per-model cost delta card (model v1->v2), 3) top-k drivers (sequence length, batch size, model). Data contract: each telemetry event must include route, model_version, token_count, batch_size, kv_cache_hit boolean.
alex (product): For rollouts we should show model-version delta inline on route cards with absolute and percent change, plus a small health indicator (error delta). That helps customers judge tradeoffs fast.
maria (eng): We can surface model_version if clients pass it. Plan: agent change to include model_version and kv-cache metrics. Small agent patch (2 dev-days) + backend ingestion mapping (3 dev-days).
marie (customer): We really need per-customer cost mapping to feed into our internal billing. Is that planned?
alex (product): Per-customer (tenant) cost is important but touches access controls and privacy. Suggest gating per-customer cost to Dedicated / Private initially as a paid add-on.
kevin (observability): Telemetry plumbing note: to compute accurate per-token costs we should capture sequence length distribution and quantization flags. Otherwise deltas will be noisy.
sam (sre): Canary guard: if a model upgrade increases per-token cost >20% for a route, we should automatically pause rollout and flag the release. Ops must be able to tweak threshold.
jordan (pm): Draft launch criteria proposal — ship as Preview behind a feature flag: (A) Cost & error cards for routes with model-version delta, (B) Trace linkability + default sampling (5% full traces + span summaries), (C) Config UI for sampling and SLO alert (basic). Advanced per-customer billing & retention tiers = post-preview.
alex (product): Agreed. Also require signal validation: show synthetic workload comparison showing cost delta for a representative traffic pattern before GA.
maria (eng): Small blocking debt: current telemetry schema lacks kv_cache_hit and token_count in some SDKs. Need agent fix and matrix rollouts to all languages. Estimate 4 dev-days total across SDKs.
kevin (observability): Simple anomaly detector suggestion: per-route hourly cost z-score + alert if z > 3. Keep it lightweight for Preview.
sam (sre): Storage estimate needed from @kevin: with 5% sampling and span summaries at 100% what are ingestion GB/day for a 100k reqs/hr customer? We need numbers to finalize retention defaults.
kevin (observability): I'll run a back-of-envelope and post numbers in the doc. Preliminary: span summaries are tiny (~200 bytes/event), full trace avg ~20KB. At 100k rph, span summaries ~5GB/day, 5% full traces ~240MB/day. Will refine.
jordan (pm): Prioritization: Must-have list gets allocated first 60% of sprint capacity: telemetry agent changes + ingestion mapping + basic dashboard v1. Nice-to-have: per-customer billing, advanced sampling UI, anomaly detector improvements.
marie (customer): One ask: include a CSV export of per-route cost deltas so finance can ingest it. Helpful.
alex (product): Noted — add CSV export to the preview backlog as a small item.
maria (eng): QA plan: I'll spin up a synthetic runner that exercises different seq lengths, batch sizes, and model versions to validate delta calculations. Will need a test dataset and a staging dashboard.
jordan (pm): Action items (owners & rough due dates): - maria (eng): prototype trace-id propagation + agent tags (due +7d) - kevin (observability): dashboard wireframes + data contract + initial ingestion estimate (due +10d) - sam (sre): sampling defaults doc + canary guard thresholds + storage impact (due +5d) - alex (product): scope memo for per-customer costing + privacy constraints (due +14d)
alex (product): I'll draft the scope memo now and link it here when ready. Any objections to preview behind feature flag and gating per-customer billing to Dedicated?
kevin (observability): fine with that.
marie (customer): +1 on gating — we need the data but can wait for Dedicated gating.
maria (eng): small note: will need product sign-off on telemetry SDK changes for stable API.
jordan (pm): Cool. Reconvene in 1 week for progress check. Tagging follow-ups: @maria (eng) @kevin (observability) @sam (sre) @alex (product).
ci-bot: deploy scheduled to staging: telemetry-agent v0.31 -> will run smoke tests for propagation.
alex (product): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
